about:
Leclerc Foods, a family-owned food manufacturer, was founded in 1905 and operates its U.S. headquarters in Kingsport, Tennessee. The business began as a small cookie and cracker bakery and has been passed down through five generations of the founding family, expanding into a multi-facility operation spanning both the United States and Canada.

Today the company produces cookies, snack bars, and crackers across eight plants—two in Kingsport, one in Montgomery, Pennsylvania, and five in Quebec and Ontario. Its production lines run at high volume, turning out roughly 8,000 snack bars per minute and more than 150,000 pallets annually, while using about 16 million kilograms of flour each year. Specialized lines include certified peanut-free and gluten-free products developed in the company's Health and Wellness Laboratory.

Leclerc Foods supplies food-service distributors, retail grocery chains, and direct-to-consumer channels under brands such as Célébration, Go Pure, Tradition 1905, and Chocomax. Its customer base includes institutional food-service operators and North American retailers seeking private-label or branded baked goods.

The company cites its five-generation family stewardship, commitment to premium ingredients, and in-house recipe innovation as key differentiators. Its Health and Wellness Laboratory focuses on formulations that meet evolving nutritional expectations, while the firm maintains peanut-free and gluten-free certifications to address allergen concerns.
